text: they are not bad. i think you could get away with a lot if you introduced a popover that, maybe when i then move the mouse over it could interact with the model in a interactive viewer and that just solves all that problem of how to take a photo of what looks like shit anyways
resolution: Called off by the user (req_1916). The plan was a hover-dwell popover that opens an interactive orbit/zoom ModelViewer for a prop tile, sidestepping the bake-an-image problem entirely. After seeing the auto-framed thumbnails land (req_1898), the user decided it isn't worth the trouble: the underlying models look rough regardless, so a bigger/interactive view would just show 'the shit in 4k'. No popover built; the framed live thumbnails stand as the answer. The Tooltip dwell pattern (delayMs + onHoverEnter/onHoverExit) is noted if it's ever revived.
